title: gDNA Extraction of Eucalypts pauciflora for Genome Sequencing
author: Alejandro Morales Suarez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j7ecrje

Contains 0.5 % sodiumdisulfite and 4 % PVP-40 (K29-32) Sigma To make 120 mL: 0.6 g sodiumdisulfite 4.8 g PVP-40 50 mL extraction buffer 50 mL lysis buffer 20 mL sarcosyl To make 30 mL: 0.15 g sodiumdisulfite 1.2 g PVP-40 12.5 mL extraction buffer 12.5 mL lysis buffer 5 mL sarcosyl Proteinase K (0.1 mg/mL of fresh working buffer). This is 30 uL of Qiagen proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
Re-suspend pellet in 50 µL of sterilised water.

steps.title: Sterilize equipment and prepare reagents
steps.instruction: Autoclave mortar and pestles. Prepare sterile 2 mL and 1.5 mL tubes. Make a chloroform:isoamyl alcohol mixture (24:1) and 77 % ethanol. Place 100 % isopropanol in the freezer. Heat fresh working buffer to 65 °C.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Grind one leaf in a mortar and pestle under liquid nitrogen to a fine powder, keeping the material frozen; transfer the powder to a 2 mL tube and store at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and RNase
steps.instruction: Aliquot 800 µL fresh working buffer into each tube (swirl buffer before adding). Add 8 µL RNase, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL proteinase K to each tube, mix, incubate 10 min at 50 °C, then inactivate at 65 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: High‑temperature incubation and cooling
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 65 °C for 1–1.5 h, inverting every 20 min. Cool tubes for at least 5 min.

steps.title: Organic extraction with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, invert 30 times.

steps.title: Phase separation and isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Spin at 3 000 × g at room temperature for 20 min. Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube, record its volume, add the same volume of ice‑cold isopropanol, and invert 10 times.

steps.title: Ethanol washes and pellet drying
steps.instruction: Next day spin at 3 000 × g for 30 min; discard supernatant. Add 1.5 mL 77 % ethanol, vortex briefly, and leave 20 min. Spin at 14 000 × g for 20 min. Add 1.5 mL 77 % ethanol, vortex, and leave in the fridge overnight (up to two nights). Next day spin at 14 000 × g for 20 min. Add 1.5 mL 77 % ethanol, vortex, leave 20 min, then spin at 14 000 × g for 20 min. Discard supernatant and dry the pellet on the bench for 30 min (or until completely dry).

steps.title: Assess crude DNA quality
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet, load 1 µL on a 0.8 % agarose gel, and compare the band pattern with Qubit measurements (ng/µL).

steps.title: Store crude DNA
steps.instruction: Store the crude DNA samples at –20 °C until they are processed with the Zymo purification plate.

steps.title: Prepare aliquots for Zymo kit
steps.instruction: Take 25 µL of each sample, split into two labelled 1.5 mL tubes, add 125 µL sterile water to each tube, and mix well.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Zymo plate
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL DNA binding buffer to each tube, vortex, and let stand for 20 min.

steps.title: Load samples onto Zymo plate and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Place the Zymo plate on a waste plate, transfer the samples into the wells, record well locations, and balance the plate with a spare plate to 0.01 g. Spin at 3 000 × g for 5 min; if any solution remains, increase speed to 3 500–5 000 × g and spin again (repeat as needed). Once all solution has passed through, spin again at 3 000 × g for 2 min.

steps.title: Wash bound DNA
steps.instruction: Discard waste, place a clean waste plate beneath the Zymo plate (ensure filters do not touch the bench), add 200 µL wash buffer, balance to 0.01 g, and spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min. Add another 200 µL wash buffer, spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min, verify complete flow‑through, and perform an extra spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min if needed.

steps.title: First elution of DNA
steps.instruction: Replace the waste plate with a PCR plate (filters must not touch the bench), add 20 µL TE buffer to each well, incubate 30 min, then spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min. Collect the eluate (first elution), seal and label the PCR plate.

steps.title: Second elution of DNA
steps.instruction: Place the Zymo plate on a second PCR plate, add 15 µL TE buffer to each well, incubate 30 min, spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min, and collect the eluate (second elution).

steps.title: Third elution of DNA
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution steps using 10 µL TE buffer (add, incubate 30 min, spin at 3 000 × g for 2 min) and collect the eluate (third elution).

steps.title: Collect eluates and final check
steps.instruction: Transfer all eluates from the PCR plates into small sterile tubes (max 600 µL), label them, and store until needed. Run 1 µL of each eluate on a 1 % agarose gel and compare the results with Qubit measurements (ng/µL).

steps.title: Final storage of purified DNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA samples at –20 °C.
